title: FormPluginDocumentTypeNode

__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

programKey.description: `None` for the Patient type, whose context is fixed.

existingEntryProgram.description: The program the existing entry is in (`OWNED` or `UNOWNED`), where its context is a program's: what a take-over keeps the type under unless its key is moved, so a screen can start the key on it.

blanksOldUi.description: True when installing would leave the type's form blank on sites still running the old client, which install refuses unless the type is named in `blankOldUi`.

refusals.description: The refusals no choice in `installUploadedPlugin` can get past, in the words that mutation would refuse with: a schema version already installed with other content, a version documents are pinned to left out, a take-over that changes the deployment's rules or lacks its current version, a second patient type. Empty when install could go ahead with the right choices.

description: One document type a form plugin declares, checked against this server.
